opomba: Fotografije iz src/assets/foto/{orkester,zgodovina}. Mapa hero/ ni tu - je gradivo za naslovnico. Fotografije s TODO dovoljenjem (sinatra-novi-trg-2013-zakrajsek, kotar-publika-2013-zakrajsek, mejnik-nishville-2018-pozrl, koncert-javornik-oder-sirse) so izpuscene, dokler dovoljenja niso potrjena. Polje mesec je vpisano samo tam, kjer je znan; leto null pomeni, da letnica po manifestu ni potrjena. Polje priblizno = letnica je ocena. fotografije.podnapis: Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu, festival Mozaik kulture, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2026 — celoten orkester
fotografije.podnapisEn: A Tribute to Gordon Goodwin, Mozaik kulture festival, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2026 — the full orchestra
fotografije.alt: Big band v celoti na zatemnjenem odru: ritem sekcija s klaviaturami, kontrabasom, kitaro in bobni na levi, pihalne sekcije za pulti na desni, dirigent pred njimi.
fotografije.altEn: The full big band on a darkened stage: rhythm section with keyboard, double bass, guitar and drums on the left, wind sections behind their stands on the right, the conductor in front of them.

fotografije.podnapis: Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu, festival Mozaik kulture, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2026 — napoved z odra
fotografije.podnapisEn: A Tribute to Gordon Goodwin, Mozaik kulture festival, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2026 — announcement from the stage
fotografije.alt: Govorec z listkom v roki stoji pri mikrofonu na sprednjem robu odra, orkester sedi za njim.
fotografije.altEn: A speaker holding notes stands at a microphone at the front of the stage, the orchestra seated behind.

fotografije.podnapis: Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu, festival Mozaik kulture, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2026 — pihala med izvedbo
fotografije.podnapisEn: A Tribute to Gordon Goodwin, Mozaik kulture festival, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2026 — winds in performance
fotografije.alt: Pihalne sekcije od blizu med igranjem: saksofoni v prvi vrsti, trobente in trombon za njimi, dirigent s hrbtom proti objektivu nad partituro.
fotografije.altEn: The wind sections close up while playing: saxophones in the front row, trumpets and a trombone behind them, the conductor seen from behind over the score.

fotografije.podnapis: Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu, festival Mozaik kulture, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2026 — orkester z dirigentom
fotografije.podnapisEn: A Tribute to Gordon Goodwin, Mozaik kulture festival, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2026 — orchestra with conductor
fotografije.alt: Sproščen trenutek med skladbama: dirigent z dvignjeno roko pri pultu, nasmejani člani orkestra z inštrumenti v rokah.
fotografije.altEn: A relaxed moment between numbers: the conductor at the stand with a raised arm, smiling players holding their instruments.

fotografije.podnapis: Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu, festival Mozaik kulture, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2026 — orkester med izvedbo
fotografije.podnapisEn: A Tribute to Gordon Goodwin, Mozaik kulture festival, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2026 — the orchestra in performance
fotografije.alt: Kader z odra med skladbo: v prvi vrsti saksofoni pri mikrofonih, za njimi trobente in trombon, ob desnem robu kadra dirigent nad partituro.
fotografije.altEn: A view of the stage during a number: saxophones at their microphones in the front row, trumpets and a trombone behind them, the conductor over the score at the right edge of the frame.

fotografije.podnapis: Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu, festival Mozaik kulture, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2026 — saksofonska in trobilna sekcija
fotografije.podnapisEn: A Tribute to Gordon Goodwin, Mozaik kulture festival, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2026 — saxophone and brass sections
fotografije.alt: Od blizu: v prvi vrsti igrajo saksofonisti, za njimi trobentači, ob levem robu kadra dirigent s hrbtom proti objektivu.
fotografije.altEn: Close up: saxophonists playing in the front row, trumpeters behind them, and the conductor at the left edge of the frame seen from behind.

fotografije.podnapis: Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu, festival Mozaik kulture, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2026 — solista Tomaž Zevnik (klarinet) in Klemen Kotar (flavta)
fotografije.podnapisEn: A Tribute to Gordon Goodwin, Mozaik kulture festival, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2026 — soloists Tomaž Zevnik (clarinet) and Klemen Kotar (flute)
fotografije.alt: Tomaž Zevnik s klarinetom in Klemen Kotar s flavto stojita pred sedečim orkestrom, vsak pri svojem mikrofonu; za njima kitarist in ritem sekcija.
fotografije.altEn: Tomaž Zevnik on clarinet and Klemen Kotar on flute stand in front of the seated orchestra, each at a microphone; the guitarist and rhythm section behind them.

fotografije.podnapis: Jazz klub Kazina pred koncertom, 2026
fotografije.podnapisEn: Kazina Jazz Club before the concert, 2026
fotografije.alt: Prazen oder pred koncertom: notni pulti, klavir, bobni in odloženi trobili, v ozadju svetleče črke KAZINA.
fotografije.altEn: An empty stage before the concert: music stands, a piano, drums and brass instruments set down, the illuminated KAZINA letters behind.

fotografije.podnapis:
Projekt Flying Start, skupna vaja orkestra z gosti, 2024 —
Tadej Tomšič (dirigent), Petra Vidmar (vibrafon), Žiga Kožar (bobni), Erik Čebokli (bas)
fotografije.podnapisEn:
Flying Start project, joint rehearsal with guest musicians, 2024 —
Tadej Tomšič (conductor), Petra Vidmar (vibraphone), Žiga Kožar (drums), Erik Čebokli (bass)
fotografije.alt: Črno-bela skupinska fotografija po vaji: orkester in gostujoči glasbeniki stojijo na odru z dvignjenimi inštrumenti — trombonami, trobentami in saksofoni; na desni vibrafon, na sredini sedi dirigent za pultom.
fotografije.altEn: A black-and-white group photo after the rehearsal: the orchestra and guest musicians stand on stage with their instruments raised — trombones, trumpets and saxophones; a vibraphone on the right, the conductor seated at the stand in the middle.

fotografije.podnapis: Rudi Javornik na prireditvi ob 70-letnici VVZ Kekec, Športna dvorana Brinje, Grosuplje, 2023
fotografije.podnapisEn: Rudi Javornik at the 70th anniversary celebration of the Kekec kindergarten, Brinje Sports Hall, Grosuplje, 2023
fotografije.alt: Dirigent z očali za notnim pultom med nastopom, z iztegnjeno roko; v ozadju polne tribune športne dvorane.
fotografije.altEn: The conductor in glasses at the music stand during the performance, one arm outstretched; the full bleachers of a sports hall behind him.

fotografije.podnapis: Rudi Javornik na generalki pred koncertom z Urošem Perićem in The Pearlettes, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 22. 4. 2022 — koncert je odprl prenovljeno dvorano
fotografije.podnapisEn: Rudi Javornik at the dress rehearsal for the concert with Uroš Perić and The Pearlettes, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 22 April 2022 — the concert reopened the renovated hall
fotografije.alt: Pogled z odra: dirigent z obema dvignjenima rokama za pultom, v ospredju hrbti sedečih glasbenikov in notni pulti.
fotografije.altEn: A view from within the orchestra: the conductor with both hands raised at the stand, the backs of seated players and music stands in the foreground.

fotografije.podnapis: Generalka pred koncertom z Urošem Perićem, Kulturni dom Grosuplje, 2022 — dirigent Rudi Javornik
fotografije.podnapisEn: Dress rehearsal for the concert with Uroš Perić, Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2022 — conductor Rudi Javornik
fotografije.alt: Dirigent za notnim pultom pod odrskimi reflektorji z dvignjeno roko; v ospredju tenor saksofon na stojalu in glava glasbenika, v ozadju prazna dvorana.
fotografije.altEn: The conductor at the music stand under stage spotlights with a raised hand; a tenor saxophone on its stand and a player’s head in the foreground, the empty auditorium behind.

fotografije.podnapis: Klemen Kotar na samostojnem koncertu v atriju NUK, Ljubljana, 2022 — gost vokalni solist Peter Savizon
fotografije.podnapisEn: Klemen Kotar at the orchestra’s concert in the atrium of the National and University Library (NUK), Ljubljana, 2022 — guest vocalist Peter Savizon
fotografije.alt: Enobarvna fotografija od blizu: dirigent s kodrastimi lasmi z obema rokama visoko dvignjenima med vodenjem, v majici Big Banda Grosuplje; v ozadju zamegljena publika.
fotografije.altEn: A monochrome close-up: the conductor, curly-haired, both arms raised high while conducting, in a Big Band Grosuplje T-shirt; the audience blurred behind him.

fotografije.podnapis: Nishville Jazz Festival, glavni oder, Niš (Srbija), 2018
fotografije.podnapisEn: Nishville Jazz Festival, main stage, Niš (Serbia), 2018
fotografije.alt: Festivalski oder v modri svetlobi: dirigent s hrbtom proti objektivu z razprtima rokama, na levi stoji saksofonist med solom, orkester sedi za pulti z napisi Big Band Grosuplje; v ozadju velika kulisa festivala.
fotografije.altEn: A festival stage in blue light: the conductor seen from behind with arms spread, a saxophonist standing and soloing at the left, the orchestra seated behind stands marked Big Band Grosuplje; the large festival backdrop behind them.

fotografije.podnapis:
Combo zasedba Big Banda Grosuplje na dogodku ameriškega veleposlaništva v Ljubljani, 2017 —
na sliki tudi vokalni solist Peter Savizon in tedanji ameriški veleposlanik v Sloveniji Brent Hartley
fotografije.podnapisEn:
The Big Band Grosuplje combo at a U.S. Embassy event in Ljubljana, 2017 —
pictured with vocalist Peter Savizon and Brent Hartley, then U.S. Ambassador to Slovenia
fotografije.alt: Skupinska fotografija combo zasedbe na odru z inštrumenti v rokah — kitaro, pozavno, saksofonom, trobento in kontrabasom — pred osvetljenim napisom U.S. Embassy Ljubljana.
fotografije.altEn: A group photo of the combo on stage holding their instruments — guitar, trombone, saxophone, trumpet and double bass — in front of the illuminated U.S. Embassy Ljubljana sign.

fotografije.podnapis: Program Franka Sinatre »A Swingin’ Affair« z Blažem Vrbičem, 2013
fotografije.podnapisEn: Frank Sinatra programme “A Swingin’ Affair” with Blaž Vrbič, 2013
fotografije.alt: Črno-bela: pevec v temni obleki z metuljčkom poje v ročni mikrofon; za njim igrajo saksofonisti, v ozadju trobila in kitarist s polakustično kitaro.
fotografije.altEn: Black and white: a singer in a dark suit and bow tie sings into a hand-held microphone; saxophonists play behind him, with brass and a guitarist on a hollow-body guitar further back.

fotografije.podnapis: Slavnostni koncert ob 50-letnici jazza na Bledu, Festivalna dvorana Bled, 17. 7. 2010 — dirigent Igor Lunder
fotografije.podnapisEn: Gala concert marking 50 years of jazz at Bled, Bled Festival Hall, 17 July 2010 — conductor Igor Lunder
fotografije.alt: Koncert na zatemnjenem odru: dirigent s hrbtom proti objektivu z dvignjeno roko, pred njim vrsta saksofonistov za osvetljenimi pulti, v ozadju trobila.
fotografije.altEn: A concert on a darkened stage: the conductor seen from behind with a raised arm, a row of saxophonists at lit music stands in front of him, brass behind.

fotografije.podnapis: Koncert z Boškom Petrovićem (vibrafon), 2006 — ob njem mladi Vid Jamnik, udeleženec spremljajoče delavnice in solist; dirigent Igor Lunder
fotografije.podnapisEn: Concert with Boško Petrović (vibraphone), 2006 — beside him young Vid Jamnik, workshop participant and soloist; conductor Igor Lunder
fotografije.alt: Črno-bela: vibrafonist s kladivci igra na vibrafon, ob njem stoji deček s kladivcem v roki in ga opazuje; za njima saksofonska sekcija in bobni.
fotografije.altEn: Black and white: a vibraphonist plays with mallets while a boy stands beside him holding a mallet and watching; the saxophone section and drums behind them.

fotografije.podnapis: Koncert ob 90. obletnici rojstva Franka Sinatre s solistom Otom Pestnerjem, Kongo Hotel & Casino, Grosuplje, 2005 — dirigent Igor Lunder
fotografije.podnapisEn: Concert marking the 90th anniversary of Frank Sinatra’s birth with vocalist Oto Pestner, Kongo Hotel & Casino, Grosuplje, 2005 — conductor Igor Lunder
fotografije.alt: Črno-bela: pevec z mikrofonom v roki poje na sprednjem robu odra, pred orkestrom stoji dirigent s hrbtom proti objektivu; orkester v svečanih oblekah za pulti, na levi klaviature in kitara.
fotografije.altEn: Black and white: a vocalist sings into a hand-held microphone at the front of the stage, the conductor standing before the orchestra seen from behind; the orchestra in formal dress at their stands, keyboards and guitar on the left.

fotografije.podnapis: Koncert ob 60-letnici Mladinske knjige, Gallusova dvorana Cankarjevega doma, 2005 — dirigent Igor Lunder
fotografije.podnapisEn: Concert for the 60th anniversary of Mladinska knjiga, Gallus Hall, Cankarjev dom, 2005 — conductor Igor Lunder
fotografije.alt: Črno-bela panorama velikega odra: orkester v belih srajcah z metuljčki, klavir na levi, kitarist in bobnar v ozadju, pihala in trobila za pulti; ob desnem robu stoji dirigent.
fotografije.altEn: A black-and-white wide shot of a large stage: the orchestra in white shirts and bow ties, a grand piano at the left, guitarist and drummer behind, winds and brass at their stands; the conductor standing at the right edge.

fotografije.podnapis: »Glasba Glenna Millerja in Counta Basiea« ob stoti obletnici rojstva obeh, samostojni koncert, 2004 — dirigent Igor Lunder
fotografije.podnapisEn: “The Music of Glenn Miller and Count Basie”, centenary concert, 2004 — conductor Igor Lunder
fotografije.alt: Črno-bela: dirigent s hrbtom proti objektivu z dvignjeno taktirko, pred njim sedeča vrsta saksofonistov, za njimi trobentači; v ozadju poslikana kulisa s krogom in napisom Grosuplje.
fotografije.altEn: Black and white: the conductor seen from behind with a raised baton, a seated row of saxophonists in front of him and trumpeters behind; a painted backdrop with a circle and the word Grosuplje.

fotografije.podnapis: Orkester z dirigentom Igorjem Lundrom po vaji v Kulturnem domu Grosuplje, 2004
fotografije.podnapisEn: The orchestra with conductor Igor Lunder after a rehearsal at Grosuplje Cultural Centre, 2004
fotografije.alt: Skupinska fotografija med sedeži v dvorani: mladi glasbeniki v vsakdanjih oblačilih držijo inštrumente — pozavno, trobente, saksofone in palice za bobne.
fotografije.altEn: A group photo among the auditorium seats: young musicians in everyday clothes holding their instruments — trombone, trumpets, saxophones and drumsticks.

fotografije.podnapis: Člani Big Banda Grosuplje s prvim dirigentom Bracom J. Doblekarjem pri spomeniku s simbolom občine na tržnici v Grosupljem, okoli 2002
fotografije.podnapisEn: Big Band Grosuplje members with first conductor Braco J. Doblekar at the monument bearing the municipal symbol on Grosuplje market square, c. 2002
fotografije.alt: Barvna skupinska fotografija na prostem: mladi glasbeniki z inštrumenti — kontrabasom, klaviaturo, saksofoni, trobentami in pozavno — stojijo na stopnicah kamnitega spomenika, v ozadju vrbe in stojnice tržnice; v sredini čepi starejši moški v sončnih očalih.
fotografije.altEn: A colour group photo outdoors: young musicians with their instruments — double bass, keyboard, saxophones, trumpets and trombone — standing on the steps of a stone monument, willow trees and market stalls behind them; an older man in sunglasses crouches in the middle.
